set(T386 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../tiny386")

if(NOT EXISTS "${T386}/pc.c")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "tiny386 sources missing: expected the vendored tree in ${T386}")
endif()

# fmopl.inc (OPL2 tables) is generated by a host build of fmopl.c, as tiny386's
# `make prepare` does. It goes into the build tree, not the tiny386 tree.
set(FMOPL_GEN_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tiny386_gen")
set(FMOPL_INC "${FMOPL_GEN_DIR}/fmopl.inc")
# (not during the early requirements scan; host tools only on PATH, the IDF
# environment can shadow `as`)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_EARLY_EXPANSION AND
   (NOT EXISTS "${FMOPL_INC}" OR "${T386}/fmopl.c" IS_NEWER_THAN "${FMOPL_INC}"))
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${FMOPL_GEN_DIR}")
    find_program(HOST_CC NAMES cc gcc clang PATHS /usr/bin /usr/local/bin NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
    execute_process(
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E env PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
                ${HOST_CC} -DGENTABLE "${T386}/fmopl.c" -o "${FMOPL_GEN_DIR}/fmoplgen" -lm
        RESULT_VARIABLE rc)
    if(NOT rc EQUAL 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "building the fmopl table generator failed")
    endif()
    execute_process(
        COMMAND "${FMOPL_GEN_DIR}/fmoplgen"
        OUTPUT_FILE "${FMOPL_INC}"
        RESULT_VARIABLE rc)
    if(NOT rc EQUAL 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "generating fmopl.inc failed")
    endif()
endif()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS
        "esp_main.c"
        "lcd_tab5.c"
        "audio_tab5.c"
        "storage_tab5.c"
        "hdd_cache.c"
        "kbd_tab5.c"
        "touch_tab5.c"
        "sdfs_serial.c"
        "net_tab5.c"
        "bsp/bsp_power.c"
        "bsp/bsp_touch.c"
        "bsp/bsp_display_tab5.c"
        "bsp/bsp_backlight.c"
        "bsp/bsp_audio.c"
        "bsp/bsp_codec_es8388.c"
        "${T386}/esp/main/usb_hid.c"
        "${T386}/esp/main/usb_input.c"
        "${T386}/adlib.c"
        "${T386}/fmopl.c"
        "${T386}/fpu.c"
        "${T386}/i386.c"
        "${T386}/i8042.c"
        "${T386}/i8254.c"
        "${T386}/i8259.c"
        "${T386}/ide.c"
        "${T386}/ini.c"
        "${T386}/pc.c"
        "${T386}/misc.c"
        "${T386}/pci.c"
        "${T386}/vga.c"
        "${T386}/vgafont.c"
        "${T386}/ne2000.c"
        "${T386}/i8257.c"
        "${T386}/sb16.c"
        "${T386}/pcspk.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "." "${T386}/esp/main" "${FMOPL_GEN_DIR}"
    REQUIRES
        esp_lcd esp_driver_i2c esp_driver_i2s esp_driver_ledc esp_driver_gpio
        esp_driver_sdmmc esp_driver_uart esp_driver_usb_serial_jtag
        nvs_flash esp_wifi esp_netif esp_event lwip espressif__esp_hosted sdmmc fatfs esp_partition esp_timer esp_psram esp_hw_support esp_mm
)

target_compile_options(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE
    -include "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/board_m5tab5.h"
    -DI386_ENABLE_FPU
    -DUSE_FMOPL
    -Wno-unused-variable -Wno-unused-function)

set_source_files_properties(
    "${T386}/adlib.c" "${T386}/fpu.c" "${T386}/i8042.c" "${T386}/ne2000.c"
    "${T386}/sb16.c" "${T386}/i8257.c" "${T386}/ide.c" "${T386}/misc.c"
    "${T386}/pci.c" "${T386}/i8254.c" "${T386}/i8259.c" "${T386}/pcspk.c"
    "${T386}/ini.c" "${T386}/vgafont.c"
    "${T386}/esp/main/usb_hid.c" "${T386}/esp/main/usb_input.c"
    PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-Wno-all")
set_source_files_properties("${T386}/fmopl.c"
    PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-Wno-all;-fsingle-precision-constant")
set_source_files_properties("${T386}/i386.c" "${T386}/vga.c" "${T386}/pc.c"
    PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-Wno-all;-O3")
